text:
Predicates:
Private(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
Research(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to location y.
YaleUniversity(y) ::: y is Yale University.
Location(y, z) ::: y is located in z.
Endowment(y, z) ::: y's endowment is valued at z.
Constituents(y, z) ::: y is organized into constituents z.
College(z) ::: z is a college.
Residences(y, z) ::: y has residence in z.
ListOfResidences(z) ::: z is a list of residences.
ResidentialColleges(z) ::: z are residential colleges.
Question:
Uncertain ::: A private Ivy League research university moved to New Haven.
Premises:
YaleUniversity(yale) ∧ Private(yale) ∧ IvyLeague(yale) ∧ Research(yale) ∧ MovedTo(yale, newHaven) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university that moved to New Haven.
